considered: decided.rs's parsers (in_body/in_comment) reused as-is; doctor's decided listing and the sweep now share App::records; Issue::place serves both DecidedNumbered and closed-issue placements; the issue aggregate's own events carry the numbers rather than a new table
author: claude-code:460ba057-9e4c-511b-a00e-1ac317d29bcb:opus
cut: In crates/domain/src/issue.rs, share one iterator for parsed body and comment records with their positions and stored IDs, and reuse one numbering application method for DecidedNumbered and closed-issue placements. In crates/factorium/src/doctor.rs and crates/factorium/src/issues.rs, consume that iterator through a shared issue scan that resolves placements and filing time. In crates/factorium/src/issues.rs, assign sweep IDs in the existing sorted order, then group placements with BTreeMap::entry to cut the manual search, push, and expect.
answer: Made all three: Issue::records yields (Place, id, record) for body and comments and replaces unnumbered_records; Issue::place is the one method DecidedNumbered's evolve and Issue::numbered use; App::records is the one scan (placements, filing time) that doctor's decided and the sweep consume; the sweep assigns ids in sorted order and groups with BTreeMap::entry. What remains is the number sequence aggregate, the marks on issue events, edit renumbering, decided D<n>, and tests.
